scripts.dev: npm run build -w @brand-studio/ui && npm run dev -w @brand-studio/showcase -- --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.build: npm run build -w @brand-studio/ui && npm run build -w @brand-studio/showcase
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/ui/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/showcase/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck -w @brand-studio/docs
scripts.pack:ui: npm run build -w @brand-studio/ui && npm pack -w @brand-studio/ui --pack-destination artifacts
scripts.dev:docs: npm run build -w @brand-studio/ui && npm run dev -w @brand-studio/docs
scripts.build:docs: npm run build -w @brand-studio/ui && npm run build -w @brand-studio/showcase && npm run build -w @brand-studio/docs && node scripts/copy-examples.mjs
